| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ἀπόλλων κλυτότοξος (21.267, Ἀπόλλωνι κλυτοτόξῳ) | "Apollo famous-bowed" | "Apollo of the famous bow" | "far-shooting" (reserved for ἑκατηβόλος), "silver-bowed" (reserved for ἀργυρότοξος), "of the renowned bow" (reserved for ἀγακλυτός); κλυτός keeps "famous" |
| ἀάω · ἄτη (21.296 ἄασ’, 21.297 ἄασεν, 21.301 ἀασθείς, 21.302 ἄτην) | "bewilder" · "bewilderment" | "bewilder" · "bewilderment" (+ note: ἄτη is the clouded state of mind and the ruin it brings) | "blind folly" (turned down for ἀτασθαλίαι), "infatuate", "delude", "ruin"; the verb and noun are kept as one family so that the echo is heard |
| ἀεσίφρων (21.302, ἀεσίφρονι θυμῷ; rare compound, meaning not known) | "senseless" | "senseless" (+ note: meaning not known for certain; "senseless" is the traditional guess) | "witless-minded", "foolish-hearted" (the -φρων epithets of persons are not reused here) |
| προμνηστῖνοι (21.230; rare, derivation not known) | "one by one" | "one after another" (+ note: derivation not known; the sense comes from μηδ’ ἅμα πάντες) | "in turn", "separately" |
| ἀγκύλα τόξα (21.264) | "the curved bows" | "the curved bows" | "crooked", "bent bows"; τόξα is a plural that can stand for one bow |
| τόξα τιταίνοιτο (21.259, τίς … τιταίνοιτ’) | "stretch bows" | "bend a bow" | "string" (reserved for ἐντανύω), "draw"; τιταίνω is "stretch, strain" |
| ἑορτὴ ἁγνή (21.258–259) | "a festival … pure" | "a pure festival" (+ note: ritually clean, hallowed) | "holy" (reserved for ἠγάθεος), "sacred" (reserved for ἱερός); keeps the table's ἁγνή "pure" |
| κέλομαι (21.265, κέλεσθε) | "urge" | "tell" (… to bring) | "bid" and "bade" (reserved for ἄνωγα), "order" (reserved for κελεύω) |
| ἔξοχοι αἰπολίοισιν (21.266, αἳ πᾶσι μέγ’ ἔξοχοι αἰπολίοισιν) | "which stand out greatly among all herds of goats" | "those that stand out above all the herds" | "outstanding" (reserved for ἀριπρεπής), "finest" (adds a judgement); follows ἔξοχος Ἀχαιῶν "stood out among the Achaeans" |
| κράτος … δώσει (21.280) | "power" | "power" (… to whomever he wishes) | "victory" (picks one sense of κράτος), "mastery", "might" (the table lists "might" as reserved for κράτος, but "power" is the table's own rendering at 11.353 and is kept) |
| ὀχθήσας δ’ ἄρα εἶπεν ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’ ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζεν (whole-line speech introduction, 21.248; no object, the speaker addresses a group) | "And, vexed, he then said, and spoke a word, and called them by name:" | "Troubled, he spoke, calling them by name:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέειπε / προσέφη), "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); builds on the table's ὀχθήσας "vexed" / "troubled" (5.298) and the ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’ ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζεν formula (shipped "called them by name" at 084) |
| οἱ δ’ ἐπεὶ οὖν σπεῖσάν τ’ ἔπιόν θ’ ὅσον ἤθελε θυμός (21.273; libation-and-drinking formula) | "And they, when then they had poured libations and drunk as much as the heart wished," | "When they had poured their libations and drunk as much as their hearts wished," | "as much as they desired", "their fill" (drops θυμός); θυμός is "heart" here, as in the table's note on θυμός |
| κληΐς, of a door-fastening (21.236 κληῗσαι, 21.241 κληῗδι) | "to lock" / "with the bolt" | "to lock" / "with the bolt" | "key" (shipped for the storeroom κληΐς in the opening lines of Book 21, a hooked key), "bar"; the note says κληΐς is the general word for what fastens a door |
| δεσμὸν ἰῆλαι (21.241, ἐπὶ δεσμὸν ἰῆλαι) | "to throw a rope on" | "throwing a rope on" | "lash", "cord", "fetter" (δεσμός is "bond"; the note says so) |
| ἐπητύς (21.306, οὐ γάρ τευ ἐπητύος ἀντιβολήσεις; rare noun, derivation not certain) | "courtesy" | "courtesy" (+ note: rare noun, derivation not certain) | "kindness", "civility" (each picks one sense), "readiness of speech" (the shipped sense of the related ἐπητής) |
| ἀκομιστίη (21.284; rare noun, a- + κομίζω) | "lack of tending" | "lack of care" | "neglect", "want of nursing" |
| χανδὸν ἕλῃ (21.294; χανδόν related to χάσκω "gape", exact sense not certain) | "takes it greedily" | "takes it greedily" | "gulps", "swills" (each adds a manner the Greek does not name) |
| οἰνοβαρείων (21.304; rare, οἶνος + βάρος) | "heavy with wine" | "weighed down with wine" | "drunk", "drunken" (loses the image of weight) |
| ἐπαρξάμενοι δεπάεσσιν (21.272, with ν-movable) | "having first poured drops into the cups" | "first pouring a few drops into each cup" | follows the table's whole line νώμησαν δ’ ἄρα πᾶσιν ἐπαρξάμενοι δεπάεσσι (3.340) |
| Κένταυρος · Λαπίθαι · Πειρίθοος · Εὐρυτίων (21.295–298) | "the Centaur" / "the Lapiths" / "Peirithous" / "Eurytion" | same | "Pirithous", "Eurytus" (a different name); names in the familiar English forms |
